# biounitasym standalone program test cases (USalign-beta branch)
# run_test.py appends "-outdir ." to every case, so generated files stay in the
# case working directory and are collected as comparison artifacts.
# Format: <name> <working_dir> <arguments...>
# <working_dir> is relative to the data/ directory
#
# Covers: biounit/asymmetric-unit detection on a multi-model structure, on a
# single-chain structure, on an RNA structure, and in -dir batch mode.
# Output goes to stdout, so no generated artifacts are compared.

biounitasym_multi   .       4jhm.pdb1
biounitasym_single  .       101m.pdb
biounitasym_rna     .       1evv.pdb
biounitasym_dir     .       -dir MSTATest/ MSTATest/list.txt -suffix .pdb
